name: robo-tea:1cup!
source:
Need a break? Let's relax with a soothing cup of robo-tea!

A cute, queer visual novel awaits you. Let your worries disappear in a world where you meet some lovely bots!

In this robot world you're Galine! A guardbot who's been given a curious task...

[From [url=https://robohaven.itch.io/robo-tea1cup]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
需要休息一下吗？让我们喝一杯舒缓的机器人茶来放松一下吧！

一部可爱、古怪的视觉小说正等着你。在遇见可爱机器人的世界里，让你的烦恼消失殆尽！

在这个机器人世界里，你是盖琳！一个被赋予奇怪任务的警卫机器人……

[来自[url=https://robohaven.itch.io/robo-tea1cup]itch.io[/url]]
